title: CLI 工作区：add → list → archive → restore
description: 在真实 app.db 副本上通过 CLI 添加一个工作区，列表能看到，归档写入 archived_at，恢复后清除。全程不需要桌面端或 agent。
preconditions: 隔离 home 内含真实 app.db 副本。
expectations: add 返回 created=true 且写入 user 工作区
list --json 包含刚添加的工作区
archive 写入 archived_at，restore 清除

expectJson.message: 真实库里有 10+ 个用户工作区

db.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM workspaces WHERE name = 'harness-cli' AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT archived_at IS NOT NULL AS ok FROM workspaces WHERE name = 'harness-cli'
SELECT archived_at IS NULL AS ok FROM workspaces WHERE name = 'harness-cli'
